## Simulation

We simulate longitudinal amyloid and tau biomarker data for 1,000 subjects and fit the Bayesian disease progression model using MCMC. The subsequent plots compare trajectories on the calendar-age scale with posterior-estimated disease-time trajectories after alignment, including uncertainty bands.

```{r gene_data, echo=TRUE, results="hide", warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
set.seed(123)
res <- simu(varying_coef_code_sim, 
            varying_coef_code,
            n_subjects = 1000,
            sa = 10,
            sy = 0.07,
            outer_iter = 1,
            niter = 2000, nburnin = 1000, #thin = 1, 
            nchains = 1,
            save_res = F)

```


## Posterior prediction

We generate a separate simulated cohort and use posterior draws from the fitted model to predict disease progression for new subjects. The forward-prediction analysis conditions on amyloid observations below the specified threshold, estimates individual time shifts, and visualizes predicted trajectories with posterior uncertainty alongside observed measurements.

```{r create-pred-data, echo=FALSE, results="hide", warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
data_1 <- generate_d1(n_subjects = 200,
                          scenario = 1,
                          K = 8, 
                          Kd = 8,
                          sa = 10,
                          step = 0.25,
                          sy = 0.07,
                          start_index = 1,
                          end_index = 250,
                          target_threshold = 1, 
                          mid_point = 1, 
                          a_thresh = 1,
                          C = NULL)
    
simudata <- generate_vc(varying_coef_code_sim, data_1, 
                            scenario = 1, #iter = i,
                            save_data = FALSE, root = NULL)
    
subject_id <- data_1$constants$subject_tau
subject_tau <- simudata$constants$subject_tau
cModelsim <- simudata$cModelsim
    
data_surv <- data.frame(subject_id, cModelsim$y_sparse_tau, cModelsim$tt) |> 
      filter(cModelsim.y_sparse_tau >= 1, subject_id %in% subject_tau) |> #filter(cModelsim.t > 5) |> 
      group_by(subject_id) |>
      slice_min(cModelsim.tt, n=1, with_ties = F) |>
      ungroup()

data_surv$censored <- rbinom(nrow(data_surv),1, prob=0.3)
data_surv$thresh <- 0
data_surv$thresh[which(data_surv$cModelsim.y_sparse_tau >= 1)] <- 1
data_surv$t <- data_surv$cModelsim.tt
data_surv$c <- data_surv$cModelsim.tt
data_surv$t[data_surv$censored == 1] <- NA
data_surv$c[data_surv$censored == 0] <- Inf
    
    
    n_subjects <- data_1$constants$n_subjects
    alpha_tau_pos <- rep(Inf, n_subjects)
    alpha_tau_pos[which(1:n_subjects %in% data_surv$subject_id)] <- data_surv$cModelsim.tt
    simudata$constants$alpha_tau_pos = alpha_tau_pos[simudata$constants$tau_amy_link]
    
    simudata$constants$n_subjects_surv <- length(data_surv$subject_id)
    simudata$constants$Xsub_surv <- simudata$constants$Xsub_amy[data_surv$subject_id,]
    simudata$constants$tau_surv_link <- data_surv$subject_id
    simudata$constants$c <- data_surv$c
    
    tinit <- rep(NA, length(data_surv$subject_id))
    tinit[data_surv$censored == 1] <- data_surv$cModelsim.tt[data_surv$censored == 1] + 1
    
    simudata$inits$tt <- tinit
    simudata$inits$shape_weib <- 1
    simudata$inits$gamma_weib <- c(log(median(data_surv$cModelsim.tt, na.rm = TRUE)), rep(0, 2))
    
    simudata$inits$gamma_amy <- c(50, 0, 0)
    simudata$inits$gamma_tau <- c(55, 0, 0)
    
    # Need to truncate to respect the constraints of the integral
    simudata$inits$alpha[2, data_surv$subject_id] <- pmin(
      data_surv$cModelsim.tt - 1, 
      simudata$inits$alpha[2, data_surv$subject_id]
    )

    # Initialize tau to be same dimension as amyloid 
    
    simudata$data$censored <- data_surv$censored
    simudata$data$tt <- data_surv$t

    max_t_tau <- rep(NA, simudata$constants$n_subjects_amy)
    min_t_tau <- rep(NA, simudata$constants$n_subjects_amy)
    
    max_t_tau[simudata$constants$tau_amy_link] <- simudata$constants$max_t_tau
    min_t_tau[simudata$constants$tau_amy_link] <- simudata$constants$min_t_tau
    
    max_t_tau[-simudata$constants$tau_amy_link] <- 0
    min_t_tau[-simudata$constants$tau_amy_link] <- 120
    
    simudata$constants$max_t_tau <- max_t_tau
    simudata$constants$min_t_tau <- min_t_tau
    
    simudata$data$constraint_alpha_tau <- simudata$data$constraint_alpha_amy


```


```{r fit-pred, echo=TRUE, results="hide", warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
source('posterior code/real data bivariate plus survival data cv.R')

dta_amy <- data.frame(CENTILOIDS = simudata$cModelsim$y_sparse_amy, RID_num = data_1$constants$subject_amy,
                    age_at_scan = simudata$cModelsim$t_amy, RID = simudata$constants$subject_amy)

dta_tau <- data.frame(SUVR = simudata$cModelsim$y_sparse_tau, RID_num = data_1$constants$subject_tau,
                    age_at_scan = simudata$cModelsim$t_tau, RID = simudata$constants$subject_tau)

# Match the observation column names read by realdata_pred().
dta_amy$SUVR <- dta_amy$CENTILOIDS
dta_tau$mesial_temporal_tau_pet_metaroi <- dta_tau$SUVR
dta_surv_df <- data_surv
dta_surv_df['RID'] <- dta_surv_df['subject_id']
dta_surv_df['time'] <- dta_surv_df['t']
pred_listf <- realdata_pred(X_amy = simudata$constants$Xsub_amy, 
                            X_tau = simudata$constants$Xsub_tau, 
                            1:50, simudata$constants$tau_amy_link, dta_surv_df, res$samples, simudata, biomarker = 'amy', type = 'forward', threshold = 1)

# Use the observation ages from the selected prediction data.
pred_listf$simudata_cv$constants$t_amy <- pred_listf$simudata_pred$constants$t_amy
pred_listf$simudata_cv$constants$t_tau <- pred_listf$simudata_pred$constants$t_tau

# Map each tau observation to the corresponding subject in the joint alpha matrix.
pred_listf$simudata_cv$constants$subject_tau <-
  pred_listf$simudata_cv$constants$tau_amy_link[
    pred_listf$simudata_pred$constants$subject_tau
  ]

pred_listf$simudata_cv$inits$gamma_amy <- NULL
pred_listf$simudata_cv$inits$gamma_tau <- NULL


source('posterior code/real data mcmc_posterior.R')
source('posterior code/posterior predictive distribution.R')
posterior_res_forward <- mcchains(posterior_predictions_code,
                                  pred_listf$simudata_cv,
                                  monitors = c("alpha", "gamma_amy_post", "gamma_tau_post",
                                               "f_pred_amy_post", "f_pred_tau_post",
                                               "rho_post"),
                                  niter = 1000,
                                  nburnin = 500,
                                  thin = 1,
                                  nchains = 1,
                                  fullres = TRUE)


```

```{r plot-pred-desc, echo=FALSE, results="hide", warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
samples <- posterior_res_forward$samples
alpha_amy <- colMedians(samples[,grep("alpha", colnames(samples))])[seq(1, 10, by = 2)]
alpha_amy_upper <- colQuantiles(samples[,grep("alpha", colnames(samples))], probs = 0.975)[seq(1, 10, by = 2)]

#xg <- colMeans(samples[,grep("xg", colnames(samples))])
alpha_amy <- unname(alpha_amy)
dta2['age_adjusted'] <- NA
dta2$age_adjusted <- dta2$age_at_scan - alpha_amy[match(dta2$RID, sort(unique(dta2$RID)))]
#dta2$age_adjusted <- dta2$age_at_scan - alpha_amy[dta2$RID_num]

f_amy <- colMedians(samples[,grep("f_pred_amy", colnames(samples))])
f_amy_upper <- colQuantiles(samples[,grep("f_pred_amy", colnames(samples))], probs = 0.975)
f_amy_lower <- colQuantiles(samples[,grep("f_pred_amy", colnames(samples))], probs = 0.025)

plot_data_amy_pred <- data.frame(fp = f_amy, fp_lci = f_amy_lower, fp_uci = f_amy_upper, da = v_pred)

g2_amy_pred <- ggplot(dta2, aes(x = age_adjusted, y = SUVR, group = RID, color = factor(RID))) +
geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +

geom_line(data = plot_data_amy, aes(x = da, y = fp_uci), color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
geom_line(data = plot_data_amy, aes(x = da, y = fp),
linewidth = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE)# + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-39, 170))


dta3 <- dta2 %>%
 # filter(n() > 4) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
 # filter(RID %in% head(unique(RID), 5)) %>%
  mutate(gp = if_else(SUVR > 1, 1, 0))

plot_data_amy_pred <- data.frame()

cn <- colnames(samples)

# 如果是 posterior prediction model，优先提取 f_pred_amy_post
f_prefix <- if (any(startsWith(cn, "f_pred_amy_post["))) {
  "f_pred_amy_post"
} else {
  "f_pred_amy"
}

f_cols <- cn[startsWith(cn, paste0(f_prefix, "["))]
f_cols <- f_cols[
  order(as.integer(sub(".*\\[([0-9]+)\\]$", "\\1", f_cols)))
]

f <- as.matrix(samples[, f_cols, drop = FALSE])

stopifnot(ncol(f) == length(v_pred))

for (id in 1:5) {

  # Get alpha_amy for subject id
  alpha <- samples[,grep("alpha", colnames(samples))][,2*id-1]

  # Match prediction ID to original RID
  dsub <- dta3 %>% filter(RID == pred_listf$pred_id[id])

  # Common calendar-age grid
  age_grid <- seq(
    mean(dsub$age_at_scan) - 20,
    mean(dsub$age_at_scan) + 25,
    by = 0.25
  )

  # Align each posterior curve to calendar age
  f_new <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = nrow(f),
    ncol = length(age_grid)
  )

  for (m in seq_len(nrow(f))) {

    shifted_age <- v_pred + alpha[m]

    f_new[m, ] <- approx(
      x = shifted_age,
      y = f[m, ],
      xout = age_grid,
      rule = 1
    )$y
  }

  # Posterior summaries
  qfun <- function(x, p) {
    if (all(is.na(x))) return(NA_real_)
    unname(quantile(x, probs = p, na.rm = TRUE))
  }

  f_amy <- apply(f_new, 2, qfun, p = 0.5)
  f_amy_lower <- apply(f_new, 2, qfun, p = 0.025)
  f_amy_upper <- apply(f_new, 2, qfun, p = 0.975)

  plot_data_amy_pred_meta <- data.frame(
    fp = f_amy,
    fp_lci = f_amy_lower,
    fp_uci = f_amy_upper,
    da = age_grid,
    RID = pred_listf$pred_id[id]
  )

  plot_data_amy_pred <- rbind(
    plot_data_amy_pred,
    plot_data_amy_pred_meta
  )
}
```
